briefdescription.para: A cache of @llvm.assume intrinsics used by SimplifyInstruction.

detaileddescription.para: That map is used to simplify some Phi nodes as we iterate over it, so it should have deterministic iterators. We could use a MapVector, but since basic blocks have numbers, using these are more efficient.

briefdescription.para: For each PHI node, keep track of which entry in Allocas it corresponds to.

For each alloca, keep an instance of a helper class that gives us an easy way to update assignment tracking debug info if the alloca is promoted.
A set of dbg.assigns to delete because they've been demoted to dbg.values.

briefdescription.para: Determine which blocks the value is live in.

detaileddescription.para: These are blocks which lead to uses. Knowing this allows us to avoid inserting PHI nodes into blocks which don't lead to uses (thus, the inserted phi nodes would be dead).

briefdescription.para: Recursively traverse the CFG of the function, renaming loads and stores to the allocas which we are promoting.
